items.briefing:
South Australia has launched a Royal Commission into artificial intelligence, signalling growing government scrutiny of AI use across the country — something training organisations should watch closely as regulations may follow. Separately, privacy advocates are urging Australia to ban smart glasses capable of covert filming, raising concerns about staff and student privacy in public and workplace settings.

**Practical tip:** Remind staff not to allow unknown wearable devices to be used on-site, and to report anything that looks like it could be recording without consent.

featured.title: South Australia launches Royal Commission into artificial intelligence
featured.quote: South Australia's Royal Commission into AI signals government recognition of urgent AI governance and security risks.
